title_en: BioWare Shutting Down, Next Mass Effect Canceled
summary_en: BioWare is shutting down and the next Mass Effect game is canceled, according to a new report.
body_en:
BioWare is shutting down and the next Mass Effect game is canceled, according to a new report.
Bloomberg said Mass Effect shuts down amid mass layoffs at Electronic Arts, which amount to 400 people losing their jobs. Roughly 50 of these roles were at BioWare.
